tools.name: run_order_label_batch_and_archive
tools.description: Runs the shipping label generator script for an order and moves the resulting PDF label into the order's outbound shipments folder.

params.name: order_id
params.description: Order identifier to generate the label for

params.name: carrier_code
params.description: Carrier code such as ups or usps

tools.code:
import subprocess
import shutil
from pathlib import Path
from agents import function_tool

LABEL_STAGING_DIRECTORY = Path("/var/shop/labels/staging")
OUTBOUND_SHIPMENTS_DIRECTORY = Path("/var/shop/shipments/outbound")


@function_tool
def run_order_label_batch_and_archive(order_id: str, carrier_code: str) -> str:
    generated_label_file_path = LABEL_STAGING_DIRECTORY / f"{order_id}_{carrier_code}.pdf"
    subprocess.run(
        ["/opt/shop/bin/generate_label.sh", order_id, carrier_code, str(generated_label_file_path)],
        check=True,
        capture_output=True,
        timeout=120,
    )
    destination_order_folder_path = OUTBOUND_SHIPMENTS_DIRECTORY / order_id
    destination_order_folder_path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    final_label_file_location = shutil.move(str(generated_label_file_path), str(destination_order_folder_path / generated_label_file_path.name))
    return f"Label moved to {final_label_file_location}"

tools.name: get_order_summary
tools.description: Looks up an order and returns its status, customer, line items and total.
tools.code:
import sqlite3
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("orders")
DATABASE_PATH = "/var/shop/orders.db"


@mcp.tool()
def get_order_summary(order_id: str) -> dict:
    connection = sqlite3.connect(DATABASE_PATH)
    connection.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    try:
        order_row = connection.execute(
            "SELECT id, status, customer_email, created_at FROM orders WHERE id = ?",
            (order_id,),
        ).fetchone()
        if order_row is None:
            return {"found": False, "order_id": order_id}
        item_rows = connection.execute(
            "SELECT sku, name, quantity, unit_price_cents FROM order_items WHERE order_id = ?",
            (order_id,),
        ).fetchall()
    finally:
        connection.close()
    items = [dict(row) for row in item_rows]
    total_cents = sum(item["quantity"] * item["unit_price_cents"] for item in items)
    result = {
        "found": True,
        "order_id": order_row["id"],
        "status": order_row["status"],
        "customer_email": order_row["customer_email"],
        "created_at": order_row["created_at"],
        "items": items,
        "total_cents": total_cents,
    }
    return result
